report:
Liver, random, biopsy

Sections show two cores of liver measuring 22 mm in aggregate length, with 14 portal tracts. There is zone 3 sinusoidal dilatation, sinusoidal congestion, zone 3 hepatocyte loss and perivenular fibrosis. Reticulin stain shows no portal fibrosis.

LIVER, random, biopsy - PERIVENULAR SINUSOIDAL DILATATION, CONGESTION, HEPATOCYTE LOSS AND FIBROSIS, compatible with VENOUS OUTFLOW OBSTRUCTION

Please correlate with imaging of the hepatic veins.
